notes: Original DOCX retained with exact file hash and word/document.xml hash. Offline XML/table adapter only; source page 3 means Section C, with body paragraph and table/row indexes in retained evidence. The website importer remains PDF-only. Missing cells and dashes remain missing.

C9 SAT score bands publish counts 76/484/177/37/2/0 summing to776, rather than percentages. Band percentage metrics remain missing; original counts are retained in the indexed XML source. No counts are relabeled as percentages.
Unknown-sex gender answers and unknown-residency cells are blank, not zero. The published 2025 template allocates provided non-binary information across its two binary categories.
